senses.def: Any of a class of organic compounds formed by the cyclization of N-acyl-α-amino acids; they are five-membered heterocycles containing both a nitrogen and oxygen atom in the ring, with the oxygen adjacent to a carbonyl.
An acylampicillin antibiotic with an extended spectrum of activity and greater in vitro potency than the carboxy penicillins.
A regenerated protein fiber; textile fiber derived from a protein such as casein (milk) or zein (maize).
A textile made of these fibers.
